items.title: Disney, Mark Goldbridge and more sports: What next for The Overlap's podcast empire?
items.summary: The Overlap, the football media company started by Gary Neville, generated 2.2 billion views across platforms and 38 million monthly YouTube views last year, and was bought by UK radio group Global in January. Chief executive Scott Melvin told Sportel that because live rights are too expensive for creators, the aim is to own the conversation in the more than 150 hours a week when teams are not playing. After going ten days without discussing Ruben Amorim's sacking, it launched the hour-long Overlap Daily and partnered with fan creator Mark Goldbridge, whose United Stand channel already had 2.5 million Manchester United fans.
items.what_it_means: Creator-led media is building large, monetisable audiences around sport without owning any rights, by filling the time between matches.

items.title: Gather report shows more Fortune 500s sponsoring in women's sports
items.summary: Consulting agency Gather's third annual report compares Fortune 500 sponsorship across the WNBA and NBA, NWSL and MLS, and PWHL and NHL, and finds women's sports deals still growing faster than men's, though more slowly than last year. It identified 12 companies that sponsor only in women's sports, five of them new this year, while renewal rates sit at 86% for women's sports against 92% for men's. The gap remains wide, with the NBA holding more than twice the Fortune 500 sponsors of the WNBA and the NHL more than nine times the PWHL.
items.what_it_means: Women's sport is becoming the entry point for big brands new to sport, but a lower renewal rate shows some sponsors are still testing whether it pays back.

items.title: 65% of fans travelling abroad for concerts in Asia, report finds
items.summary: A new Concert Travel Effect in Asia report from Trip.com Group and Live Nation, based on more than 1,760 survey responses plus travel and Ticketmaster data, found 65% of concertgoers surveyed had travelled to another country or region for a show. Some 84% said they were interested in packages combining show access with travel, the ideal trip length around a show is four days, and 67% said their fan community is core to the concert experience. K-pop concerts draw nearly twice as many overseas attendees as other acts.
items.what_it_means: Concerts are increasingly driving multi-day travel spend, which makes the show the start of a bigger purchase that promoters and travel partners can package.

items.title: Skydance says it'll be 'significant player' in sports, even with debt from WBD purchase
items.summary: On its first investor call since acquiring WBD, Skydance said it will remain a significant player in sports despite a large debt load, noting that CBS Sports and TNT Sports together hold more than three dozen premium sports agreements and give it a year-round sports calendar. Executive Kevin Creighton said each rights package will be judged on audience size, engagement, advertising value, whether it drives streaming acquisition, and whether it fills a calendar gap, with every right having to earn its place. Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz highlighted that advertisers can now buy across broadcast, cable and streaming through one partner.
items.what_it_means: The newly combined CBS and TNT sports portfolio will buy rights more selectively, judging each one on whether it fills the calendar and drives streaming sign-ups.

items.title: WTA expanding consumer products program, partners with Monarch Commerce
items.summary: The WTA is launching a consumer products program, starting at this week's WTA Finals at Indian Wells with a Togethxr collaboration and a Hello Kitty licensed line, and expanding in 2027 to e-commerce and a wider licensing program. Chief brand officer Sarah Swanson said fans have never been able to buy anything representing their fandom of the WTA itself, and that the products are designed to reach different fan segments. The tour has signed Monarch Commerce for a series of drops through next year, using WTA branding, cities and tennis iconography rather than tournament or athlete marks for now.
items.what_it_means: A long-established women's tour is only now creating merchandise for its own brand, opening a new revenue stream and a way to reach new fans.

items.title: Panthers eliminating about 6,500 seats in Bank of America renovations
items.summary: Citing the Charlotte Observer, SBJ reports about 6,500 upper seats in the west end zone of Bank of America Stadium will permanently disappear to make room for a social patio, cutting capacity from 75,000 to 69,900. The Panthers are handling 1,400 PSL accounts attached to those seats, offering affected fans three options, and the buyback option has proven controversial. Another 1,000 to 1,100 nearby seats will be temporarily displaced for one or two years, and those fans are yet to be contacted.
items.what_it_means: The club is trading fixed seats for social space, and managing long-standing seat licence holders through that change is proving difficult.

items.title: Maffei-backed Horse Racing League announces details for 2027 debut
items.summary: The Horse Racing League, launched by former Liberty Media chief executive Greg Maffei and Skylark's Danny Epstien, will debut in 2027 with three race days on USA Network at Gulfstream Park, Keeneland and Santa Anita Park. Ten teams of eight horses will compete for more than $10M in prize money, with Maffei hoping to sell four teams in year one, including to celebrity partners, while six stay league-owned. He said the league will follow the storytelling model he helped install at Liberty's motorsport property, telling the stories of horses, jockeys, trainers and owners.
items.what_it_means: A new team-based format is trying to give an old sport the character-led storytelling that has grown other properties' audiences.

items.title: Ligue 1 looks to 'stress test' media rights market with complete domestic package
items.summary: Ligue 1 has taken its complete package of domestic media rights for 2027 to 2032 to market, with bids due by 3 December and a secret, ambitious reserve price, after a change to French law allowed every match and team to be sold together. This season all games air on the league's own Ligue 1+ streaming service, created after it ended its DAZN deal. LFP Media chief executive Olivier Bramly said he has spoken with close to 20 potential partners and is offering either a conventional rights deal or distribution of Ligue 1+ itself through a streamer.
items.what_it_means: Having built its own streaming service, Ligue 1 is using it as the benchmark any broadcaster must beat, and offering the service itself as an alternative to a rights deal.

items.title: Baby-care brand Coterie taps Max Homa for golf campaign highlighting parental mental labor
items.summary: Citing Marketing Brew, SBJ reports baby-care brand Coterie is moving into golf with a PSA-style campaign starring PGA Tour winner Max Homa, centred on a back-cover Golf Digest ad declaring that you never see diaper ads in golf magazines. The campaign aims to raise awareness that mothers still do most of the cognitive household labour while growing the brand's reach among fathers of young children. Homa was already a Coterie user before the partnership, and the brand has further sports marketing on its 2027 radar.
items.what_it_means: A brand outside sport is using a golf audience to reach a buyer it struggles to reach elsewhere, by placing itself where it is least expected.

items.title: P!NK Announces Sphere Residency In Las Vegas
items.summary: P!NK will play a nine-date, Live Nation-promoted residency at Sphere in Las Vegas from 29 September to 30 October 2027, the first solo female pop artist to headline the venue. Vibee is the official concert and hotel package partner, offering two-night stays at The Venetian with show tickets and VIP extras such as a fan experience lounge, crowd-free shopping hours and airport transport. Las Vegas is marking the announcement by turning the SlotZilla zipline on Fremont Street into P!NKZILLA from 11 to 19 November.
items.what_it_means: The residency is being sold as a destination trip, with hotel, VIP and city activations packaged around the show itself.
